title: Embedding candidate validation: spectral regression prober and swappable route
creator: Luca Moreno
description: Problem: new embedding candidates occasionally introduce subtle semantic shifts or high tail latency that only appear at scale or for specific tenant cohorts. Existing onboarding focuses on PR-based evals and scalar embedding metrics; we need a repeatable system that detects distributional and geometric regressions, validates reranker compatibility, and provides an automated safe-path to revert or isolate traffic without manual intervention. This ticket implements a 'spectral regression prober' that compares candidate and baseline embedding subspaces, integrated latency/throughput gating, and a swappable routing alias with tenant-level quarantine so we can safely flip models for tenants showing degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Spectral Regression Prober implemented and running as part of pre-canary checks: computes spectral alignment score between candidate and baseline on the golden set
Canary deployment workflow updated to include spectral, semantic (Recall@k / MRR), and latency fences before ramping above 1% traffic
Routing alias supports per-tenant quarantine: if tenant fails quality gate, routing shifts them to prior stable variant automatically
Telemetry dashboards show p50/p95/p99 latency, cosine-sim distribution, spectral-alignment histograms, and fraction-of-tenants-failing over last 24h
Rollback and manual override documented in runbook; automated rollback triggers validated in staging via chaos scenarios
Regression detectors raise alerts to SRE and PM channels with recommended rollback probability and example failing queries
plan: Design spectral prober: subspace comparison using top-k singular vectors + cosine alignment; implement as service that scores batch of samples
Extend golden evaluation corpus with tenant-seeded queries and domain-balanced subsets (search, rerank, semantic-match, short/long queries)
Add latency and throughput gates (p99 < threshold, GPU mem stay within limit under x qps) to the canary criteria
Implement per-tenant swappable alias in routing layer and a quarantine state machine with TTL and backoff
Wire alerts and dashboard panels in Console for spectral, semantic, and latency signals
Run staged experiments in staging -> limited production cohort -> gradual ramp; validate automatic quarantine and manual overrides
rollout_steps: Stage 0: Offline evaluation — run spectral prober on golden set, produce report (internal only)
Stage 1: Staging deploy with synthetic high-load tests and chaos injections (no customer traffic)
Stage 2: Canary 0.5% traffic to low-risk tenants + real-time telemetry (48h observation)
Stage 3: Canary 2% with tenant-quarantine enabled and automatic rollback triggers (72h observation)
Stage 4: Ramp to 10% with continuous monitoring and per-tenant isolation; if failure rate < fence, proceed to 50%
Stage 5: Global swap behind a soft-alias; schedule deprecation window for old variant after 30 days of stable metrics
telemetry_requirements: Spectral alignment score: distribution and 90th percentile shift vs baseline
Semantic quality: Recall@10, MRR, and precision on golden and tenant-sampled holdouts
Cosine distance distribution shift and frozen-statistics KS-test p-value
Latency: p50/p95/p99 at per-tenant and platform levels; GPU utilization and queue length
Failure modes: embedding norm drift, OOV token spikes, tokenization mapping deltas
Alerting thresholds and runbook links included in each dashboard tile
risk_mitigation: Per-tenant quarantine: automatically reroute failing tenants to previous model variant and mark for manual review
Soft-alias fallback: route to compatible quantized or lower-latency variant if capacity constraints triggered
Conservative default ramps: stop at each gate and require manual approval for >10% unless all gates green
Backfill compatibility checks: verify index/semantic search clients can handle new dimension sizes or alias translation
Sandbox mismatch analyzer: record top N divergent query pairs for human triage and model debugging
qa_checks: Smoke: basic embedding inference correctness for 100 sample prompts across languages
Regression: run golden set against baseline and candidate; require no more than 1.5% drop in Recall@10 on primary bucket
Load: run 2x expected peak qps on staging with KV cache warm and measure p99 GPU latency
Integration: reranker endpoint compatibility tests (ensure re-rank ranking order stable within tolerance),
Compatibility: serialization/deserialization roundtrip for new embedding shape or dtype (float16/int8)

notes: Spectral alignment approach: compute top-32 singular vectors of embeddings for baseline and candidate on same sample set; alignment = sum of squared cosine similarities between matched vectors. This detects geometric rotation/scale changes not visible to recall metrics alone.
We will keep dimensionality normalization steps to avoid false positives when shape/dtype changes (e.g., pad/trim vectors to canonical length before SVD).
Cross-team dependency: reranker tests require model contract update to include 'embedding-variant' header to allow server-side routing decisions.
This ticket deliberately separates semantic quality checks (Recall/MRR) from geometric checks (spectral) to reduce blindspots in onboarding.
If candidate reduces average embedding norm by >15% we consider it a high-risk change and require manual PM + research signoff.
